title: 赛狐ERP MCP 链接配置
description: 连接您的赛狐ERP账号。X-Mcp-Key仅存储在本机，由WorkBuddy在连接赛狐 MCP 服务时通过请求头注入。请勿向他人分享该密钥。
description_en: Connect your Saihu ERP account. X-Mcp Key is only stored locally and injected by WorkBuddy through request headers when connecting to the Saihu MCP service. Please do not share this key with others.
docLabel: 如何获取赛狐 MCP 密钥？

fields.label: MCP KEY
fields.placeholder: 在赛狐ERP的「MCP管理」页面复制鉴权密钥
fields.description: 密钥与当前赛狐账号绑定，数据访问范围继承该账号权限，密钥泄露后请立即重新生成。
